text.en: Ainu is classified as a language isolate with no demonstrated genetic relationship to any other known language family ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--ainu-classified-as-language-isolate⟧. It is further characterised as one of four coastal language families in Northeast Asia and northern Eurasia that survive from before the post-Neolithic spreads of Inner Asian language families ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--coastal-relict-lineage-northern-eurasia⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語は他のいかなる語族とも系統的関係が立証されておらず、孤立言語として分類される⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--ainu-classified-as-language-isolate⟧。さらに、ポスト新石器時代の内陸アジア型語族の拡散以前から生き残った、北東アジア・北ユーラシアにおける4つの沿岸部言語系統の1つとして特徴づけられている⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--coastal-relict-lineage-northern-eurasia⟧。

text.en: The genetic origins and external affinities of Ainu remain controversial, with no scholarly consensus having been reached ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--the-genetic-origins-and-external-affinities-of-the⟧. The hypothesis relating Ainu to the Indo-European language family, initiated by Batchelor (1887) and championed by Naert (1958), relied on inadequate descriptive materials and arbitrary sound correspondences, and currently has no supporters ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--the-hypothesis-relating-ainu-to-the-indo-european⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語の系統的起源および系統的親縁関係の問題は議論が続いており、研究者の間でいかなる合意にも達していない⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--the-genetic-origins-and-external-affinities-of-the⟧。バチェラー（1887）に始まりナエール（1958）が代表したアイヌ語と印欧語族との同系説は、当時の不十分な言語資料と恣意的な音韻対応認定に基づいており、現在では支持されていない⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--the-hypothesis-relating-ainu-to-the-indo-european⟧。

text.en: Patrie's (1982) proposal connecting Ainu to the 'Altaic family'—grouping Ainu, Japanese, and Korean together with Turkic, Mongolic, and Tungusic—is rejected as extremely improbable, its claimed sound correspondences being arbitrary and unconvincing ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--patrie-s-1982-proposal-connecting-ainu-to-the⟧.
text.ja: パトリー（1982）によるアイヌ語・アルタイ語族同系説は、日本語と朝鮮語もトルコ語諸語・モンゴル語諸語・ツングース語諸語とともに一括したものであるが、成立する蓋然性は非常に低く、音韻対応づけも恣意的で説得力がないとして退けられている⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--patrie-s-1982-proposal-connecting-ainu-to-the⟧。

text.en: Languages surrounding Ainu in the Russian Far East and adjacent areas—including Nivkh, Itermen, and Yukaghir—are likewise language isolates ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--languages-surrounding-ainu-in-the-russian-far-east⟧.
text.ja: 樺太北部とアムール川流域のニヴフ語、カムチャッカ半島のイテリメン語、サハ共和国のユカギール語など、アイヌ語の周辺に位置するロシア極東およびその隣接地域の言語もまた孤立言語である⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--languages-surrounding-ainu-in-the-russian-far-east⟧。

text.en: Chamberlain (1887) denied the genetic relationship between Ainu and Japanese on the basis of 15 points, but all of them concerned grammatical and morphological (typological) differences rather than phonological correspondences ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--chamberlain-1887-denied-the-genetic-relationship-between-ainu⟧. From the standpoint of linguistic orthodoxy, Nakagawa asserts that Chamberlain's argument cannot establish that there is no genetic relationship between Ainu and Japanese ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--from-the-standpoint-of-linguistic-orthodoxy-chamberlain-s⟧. Kindaichi (1937) largely agreed with Chamberlain, concluding that Ainu and Japanese ultimately had different origins ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--kindaichi-1937-concluded-that-ainu-and-japanese-ultimately⟧. To this day, no linguist specialising in Ainu actively argues that Ainu and Japanese are genetically related ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--to-this-day-no-linguist-specializing-in-the⟧. Hattori (1956), however, claimed that a distant genetic relationship between Ainu and Japanese is probable, citing the root *kur* (as found in *kur*, *niskur*, *kunne*, *ekurok*) and seven lexical comparisons—*kap*, *se-*, *mat*, *tek*, *an*, *ne*~*na-*, *poye* ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--hattori-1956-claimed-that-a-distant-genetic-relationship⟧.
text.ja: チェンバレン（1887）は15の項目をあげてアイヌ語と日本語の系統関係を否定したが、そこで問題にしているのは文法や形態論的な類型論的違いばかりで、音韻対応に関する項目はひとつもない⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--chamberlain-1887-denied-the-genetic-relationship-between-ainu⟧。中川は、言語学的な常識から言えば、チェンバレンの議論によってアイヌ語と日本語の間に系統関係が無いとすることはできないと主張する⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--from-the-standpoint-of-linguistic-orthodoxy-chamberlain-s⟧。金田一（1937）はチェンバレンの論考にほぼ同意し、アイヌ語と日本語は本源の違う言語だったということに帰着せざるを得ないという結論を述べた⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--kindaichi-1937-concluded-that-ainu-and-japanese-ultimately⟧。現在にいたるまで、アイヌ語を専門とする言語学者で、積極的にアイヌ語と日本語の同系説を主張している者はいない⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--to-this-day-no-linguist-specializing-in-the⟧。しかし服部（1956）は、アイヌ語と日本語に遠い親族関係がある蓋然性があると述べ、語根*kur*（*kur*、*niskur*、*kunne*、*ekurok*などに見られる）および7語—*kap*、*se-*、*mat*、*tek*、*an*、*ne*~*na-*、*poye*—の例を挙げた⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--hattori-1956-claimed-that-a-distant-genetic-relationship⟧。

text.en: The Ainuic (Kurilic) family comprises three separate languages, corresponding to Hokkaido Ainu, Sakhalin Ainu, and Northern Kuriles Ainu ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--the-ainuic-kurilic-family-comprises-three-separate-languages⟧. Linguistic evidence has been reported to point to an origin of the Ainu language on the Asiatic mainland ⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--linguistic-evidence-points-to-an-origin-of-the⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語族（千島語族）は、北海道アイヌ語、樺太アイヌ語、北千島アイヌ語という3つの個別言語から構成される⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--the-ainuic-kurilic-family-comprises-three-separate-languages⟧。また、言語学的証拠はアイヌの起源がアジア大陸にあることを示唆すると報告されている⟦claim:sources/genetic-position-macro-comparison--linguistic-evidence-points-to-an-origin-of-the⟧。
